Attribute.Name: Logistic Completeness
Attribute.ValueTemplate:
<derive expr="{
    score:=round(
        Completeness('PMDM.CM.LogisticCompleteness'),
        0
    )
}
if(
    score=0,"✧✧✧✧✧✧✧✧✧✧",
     if(
        and(score>0, score<15),
        "✦✧✧✧✧✧✧✧✧✧",
        if(
            and(score>=15, score<25),
            "✦✦✧✧✧✧✧✧✧✧",
            if(
                and(score>=25, score<35),
                "✦✦✦✧✧✧✧✧✧✧",
                if(
                    and(score>=35, score<45),
                    "✦✦✦✦✧✧✧✧✧✧",
                    if(
                        and(score>=45, score<55),
                        "✦✦✦✦✦✧✧✧✧✧",
                        if(
                            and(score>=55, score<65),
                            "✦✦✦✦✦✦✧✧✧✧",
                            if(
                                and(score>=65, score<75),
                                "✦✦✦✦✦✦✦✧✧✧",
                                if(
                                    and(score>=75, score<85),
                                    "✦✦✦✦✦✦✦✦✧✧",
                                    if(
                                        and(score>=85, score<95),
                                        "✦✦✦✦✦✦✦✦✦✧",
                                        if(score>=95, "✦✦✦✦✦✦✦✦✦✦", "")
                                    )
                                )
                            )
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        )
    )
)"/>
